verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS equity-management platform like Vestd, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookie consent, or tracking opt-out controls. The docs cover only cap tables, share issuance, EMI schemes, data rooms and shareholder comms, and the probes cover only llms.txt and API paths.
